name: repro-hub-cave-heap

scripts.build: if [ -n "$CHUGGIE_PREBUILT_ROM" ] && [ -f "$npm_package_name.gba" ]; then echo "using the prebuilt $npm_package_name.gba"; else TISH_FAST_NATIVE_BUILD=1 tish build src/main.tish --target gba -o repro-hub-cave-heap.gba; fi
scripts.start: npm run build && (mgba-qt repro-hub-cave-heap.gba || mgba repro-hub-cave-heap.gba)

description: A bug reproduction or regression test case.
